address.lineWithUnit: 34 Dr Martin Luther King Jr Drive Unit A

remarks: AVAILABLE 10/1/25. Looking for a rental that stands out? This stylish two-story loft, formerly a commercial building offers 1032 square feet, character and modern upgrades in the heart of SONO! Freshly painted with new floors, this space features exposed brick, soaring 11-ft ceilings, and skylights that flood the home with natural light. Enjoy the convenience of in-unit laundry, central air, gas heat, free parking, and a spacious walk-in closet. Plus, unwind in the cozy fire pit lounge. The best part? Step outside, and you're just across the street from the AMC theater and an array of top restaurants and bars!  Requirements: Credit score of 680+ and income must be 3x the rent no exceptions. Owner/agent.  Owner pays water, sewer, grounds maintenance and snow removal. Tenant pays for renter's insurance, electric and gas. Minimum 1 year lease term. 2 Month's Security Deposit. See included floor plans.
